scope: Storefront layered-navigation attribute filters: filterable spec definitions now drive a facet filter panel on the marketplace search

businessFlow.subject: Storefront marketplace renders a facet filter panel from filterable attributes and narrows listings when a value is selected

notes: The 'filterable' flag on attribute definitions is now functional. The public storefront search (GET /api/v1/listings) accepts spec[key]=value layered-navigation filters (validated allow-list), and a new GET /api/v1/listings/facets returns filterable attribute keys + distinct values across published listings (optionally category-scoped). The storefront marketplace renders a facet panel (CPU/GPU/Motherboard/PSU/RAM/Storage/VRAM with units) and appends spec[] params on search. Verified headed: selecting VRAM=12 sent spec[vram_gb]=12 (200) and narrowed results to the RTX 3060 12GB models; reset cleared the filter. The only console errors are the pre-existing unauthenticated /api/v1/me 401s on the public storefront.
